name: orderByRank
summary: Sort items by a DECLARED priority ranking of a category — an order deliberately NOT the category's natural/alphabetical one (an attention queue: by urgency, which no property of the state gives you). The ranking is DATA (an array, first = highest), not magic numbers buried in a comparator's ternary chain where the priority cannot be read as a list or reordered without recounting. An UNRANKED category sorts AFTER every ranked one, not to rank 0 — unranked is 'no stated priority', not 'top priority', the trap the `?? 0` hand-version falls into. Stable within a rank; decorate-sort-undecorate so the category is derived once per item, not per comparison. Harvested from the Fleet page's merge queue (#3462/#3465).
